headline: Good cuts, short waits.
intro: A busy barbershop on North Mayo Trail with real barbershop atmosphere, a full crew of barbers and short waits, even on a packed day.
reviews: Real barbershop atmosphere, excellent service, and top-tier barbers.
Gavin cut my hair perfectly made sure it was what I wanted…
Took my grandfather here for a haircut, and he really seemed to enjoy himself.

about: American Vintage Barbershop is a barbershop on North Mayo Trail in Pikeville, Kentucky. Customers say the barbers are top-tier, the hospitality is the best they've had, and the wait stays short even when it's packed.
